[s0l0!-header][h1]The CONCAT Function[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

[s0l0!-header][b]The output result is:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2818" width="100%"]
[note]The CONCAT() function takes two or more parameters.[/note]

resolved.title: AS 别名关键字
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The AS Keyword[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A concatenation results in a new column. The default column name will be the CONCAT function.
You can assign a custom name to the resulting column using the [b]AS [/b]keyword: [code format="sql" codeId="3080"]SELECT CONCAT(FirstName,', ', City) [b]AS [/b]new_column 
FROM customers;[/code]
And when you run the query, the column name appears to be changed. [img id="2819" width="100%"]
[note]A concatenation results in a new column.[/note]
resolved.description_en:

And when you run the query, the column name appears to be changed. [img id="2819" width="100%"]

resolved.title: 计算员工年薪
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定一张员工表**staff**，数据如下：

![](/content/assets/2d48738472a066cdeadf.jpeg)

列字段备注：
- `salary`: 月工资
- `experience`：工作年限

表中显示的工资`salary`是**月工资**。
每个员工年底都会有一笔年终奖。年终奖等于他们的工作年限**乘以500**。

请写一个查询，将**firstname**和**lastname**列输出到一个名为**fullname**的列中，并用空格隔开，并计算每个员工的年薪总额，总额命名为**total** 列。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The AS Keyword[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given the following [b]staff[/b] table: [img id="4516" width="100%"]
The salary shown in the table is [b]monthly[/b].
Each employee receives a bonus once a year. The bonus for each employee is equal to their years of experience [b]multiplied by 500[/b].

Write a query to output the [b]firstname[/b] and [b]lastname[/b] columns into one column named [b]fullname[/b] separated by space, and the total annual salary for each employee keeping in mind bonuses named '[b]total'.[/b] Sort by the [b]'total'[/b] column.
[note]Use the [b]AS[/b] keyword and the [b]CONCAT[/b] function![/note]

code_templates.solution_code:
SELECT CONCAT(firstname,' ', lastname) AS fullname, salary*12+experience*500 AS total 
FROM staff ORDER BY total
